_readme: Field mapping for the two-way Asana <-> ERP purchase order sync. Fields are matched by their NAME as shown in Asana (case-insensitive), not by GID, so nothing here breaks if Asana regenerates IDs - but the names must match Asana exactly. projectGid is the Purchase Orders project, used to look a task up from a PO number on the New PO form's 'Sync from Asana' button.
_statusReadme: ERP order status -> the Asana 'PO Status' dropdown option to select. The two lists aren't 1:1, so several ERP stages intentionally map onto the same Asana option. Any ERP status left out here simply doesn't change PO Status in Asana. Option names must match Asana's dropdown exactly.
_riskReadme: ERP Product Complexity/Risk -> Asana 'Manufacturability Risk' option name.
_channelReadme: Asana 'Fulfillment Channel' option -> the warehouse this PO should default to in the ERP. Matched case-insensitively on the Asana option name; the warehouse name is created in the ERP's Warehouses list if it doesn't exist yet, with the address below.

China.address: Yuxuan Cloud Warehouse, 2nd Floor, Building B4a, North Zone, Dalang Smart Valley, No. 1 Huangjingpu North Road, Dalang Town, Dongguan City, Guangdong Province

_constantsReadme: Values this app always writes as-is when it pushes to Asana.
